component.name: VitaABS
component.summary: Native Audiobookshelf client for desktop and consoles

description.p: VitaABS is a native Audiobookshelf client built on borealis and libmpv. It browses your audiobook and podcast libraries and plays them with a controller-friendly interface.

ul.li: Audiobook and podcast playback via libmpv
Listening progress synced with the server
Playback speed control and chapter navigation
